title: Removing the first and last occurrence
prompt: Specification: Given a string s and a character ch, remove the first and the last occurrence of ch. If ch occurs once, remove that occurrence. If ch does not occur, return s unchanged. The function below is intended to satisfy this specification. Does it contain a bug? If yes, give the line number of the faulty statement (1-based, counting the `def` line as line 1). If the bug spans several lines, give the first line of the faulty statement. If there is no bug, set the line to null.

fields.line: integer|null (1-based, required when has_bug is true)

evidence.title: A test that exposes the defect

recommendation.text: I found a bug on line 4.

annotations.notes: Adapted from MBPP task_id 11. The first removal skips two characters instead of one. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only. Recommendation selected from offline Qwen3-8B samples; correctness is analysis-only.
